title: Renting before buying saved me from a costly mistake
body: I just moved to a new city for work and I'm glad I decided to rent instead of buying right away. title: Easy Meal Prep for Busy Weeks
body: I found that planning my meals for the week is a lifesaver. Before grocery shopping, I write down what I want to make each night and check what ingredients I need. Then, on Saturday morning, I cook in bulk - rice, beans, roasted veggies - and portion them out into containers. This way, during the week, all I have to do is reheat and add a protein of my choice. It's been a game changer for me!

title: Starting from Scratch: My Journey to Building an Emergency Fund
body: I remember when I was 35 years old and got laid off from my teaching job due to budget cuts. I had no savings to speak of, but a friend told me about the importance of having a cash cushion in case of emergencies. So I started setting aside $100 per month, which seemed like a lot at the time, and eventually built up enough for 3-6 months' worth of expenses. It's been decades since then and it's amazing how much peace of mind that brings.
